summary: Covers managing local Windows users and groups with win_user, win_group and win_group_membership, with an example creating a group, users, a folder, and ACLs via win_acl and win_acl_inheritance.
questions: How do I create local users and groups on a Windows server with Ansible?
How can I grant a local group full control of a folder on Windows?
How do I disable ACL inheritance on a Windows directory using Ansible?
Which modules manage local Windows group membership?

answer_card.title: Managing local Windows users, groups and folder ACLs
answer_card.answer_md:
Use `win_group`, `win_user`, and `win_group_membership` for local accounts, then `win_acl` / `win_acl_inheritance` for permissions:

```yaml
- win_group:
    name: LocalGroup
- win_user:
    name: '{{ item.name }}'
    password: '{{ item.password }}'
    groups: LocalGroup
    update_password: false
    password_never_expires: true
  loop: [...]
- win_file: {path: C:\Development, state: directory}
- win_acl:
    path: C:\Development
    rights: FullControl
    type: allow
    user: LocalGroup
    state: present
- win_acl_inheritance:
    path: C:\Development
    reorganize: true
    state: absent
```
